name: priv-audit

chatParticipants.name: priv-audit
chatParticipants.description: Audit code for potential privacy artifacts and concerns.

commands.name: audit
commands.description: Audit the currently opened file for potential privacy artifacts and concerns.

disambiguation.description: The user wants to audit the currently opened file for potential privacy artifacts and concerns.

Look for potential privacy concerns in my code.

scripts.pretest: npm run compile && npm run lint
